crossRefs.note: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

translations.web: Moreover Yahweh your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.
translations.bsb: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet against them until even the survivors hiding from you have perished.
translations.kjv: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
translations.asv: Moreover Jehovah thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves, perish from before thee.
